verdict.detail: The same year as the first issue (US, CRS-8014-ST, 1972).

notes.text:
Original UK release in matte cover with pinched spine endings on black/silver labels.

The Original Motion Picture Soundtrack Written & Performed by Curtis Mayfield

℗ 1972

Recorded at RCA Studios in Chicago, Illinois - except Pusherman, wich was recorded at Bell Sound Studios in New York.
Successfully arranged and orchestrated from the original dictations of Curtis Mayfield by Johnny Pate.
Original recordings by Buddah Records, NY.
Sleeve printed and made by MacNeill Press Ltd., London, S.E.1

This version is similar to

but with differences to the labels: this version does mention 'Made in England', does not mention 'Produced by Curtis Mayfield' and credits different publishers for different tracks.

Title appears as "Super Fly" on cover, but as "Superfly" on labels.
A1 appears as "Little Child Runnin Wild" on cover, but as "Little Child Runnin' Wild" on label.
A4 apeears as "Junkie Chase" on cover, but as "Junkie Chase—Instr." on label.
B1 appears as "Give Me Your Love" on cover, but as "Give Me Your Love (Love Song)" on label.
B3 appears as "No Thing On Me" on cover, but as "Nothing On Me (Cocaine Song)" on label.
B4 appears as "Think" on cover, but as "Think—Instr." on label.

Publishing:
• Ivan Mogull - A1, A3, B2, B3, B5.
• Camad Pub. Ltd. - A2, A4, B1, B4.
